verdict.rationale: Carta's API uses OAuth 2.0 with an AUTHORIZATION_CODE grant and configurable OAuth scopes, and the docs say law firms and technology partners can fetch cap table data on behalf of the company. Personal finance partners can also aggregate equity holdings. This is delegated, scoped access rather than shared admin credentials. Missing for 10: explicit HRIS-vendor coverage, documentation of how granular scopes are and how companies grant or revoke partner consent, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
